LanguageData.LiAIChat_ActivatePhaseveilDesc: Become invisible for up to 20 seconds. Attacking or being downed ends the effect. Activation starts a 90-second cooldown and adds neural fatigue while active.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilMustBeWorn: Wear Phaseveil Armor to use this ability.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilTooFatigued: Neural fatigue is too severe to activate Phaseveil.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilUnconscious: The wearer must be conscious and standing to activate Phaseveil.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ActivateBlightShieldDesc: Absorb incoming damage using stored pollution energy. The shield lasts up to 15 seconds and adds toxic accumulation when activated.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_AbsorberMustBeWorn: Wear Blight Absorber Armor to use this ability.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_AbsorberShieldAlreadyActive: The Blight Shield is already active.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_AbsorberInsufficientEnergy: At least 30 absorber energy is required.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ActivateResonanceMantleDesc: Disrupt hostile biological pawns within 8 cells for 20 seconds. The field adds neural strain and has a 90-second cooldown.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_MantleMustBeWorn: Wear Resonance Mantle to use this ability.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_MantleAlreadyActive: The resonance field is already active.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_MantleTooStrained: Neural resonance strain is too severe to activate the mantle.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_MantleUnconscious: The wearer must be conscious and on a map to activate the mantle.
